clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, silithid antennae still twitch after they are cut free. Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo seeks them as proof of a young warrior’s speed and skill in combat before the nerves go still.

Silithid Grubs, Swarmers, Harvesters, and Creepers carry antennae that twitch after they are cut from the head. The spasms fade soon after the insects are slain. A young warrior must hunt silithid in the southern wastes and hurry back across the scrublands while the antennae still twitch. Bringing them back in time tests both speed and skill, making the hunt a rite of passage for Horde warriors.

The silithid antennae also point to a threat that troubles Camp Taurajo’s hunters. Silithid are not native to the Barrens, and their new burrowing mounds at the Field of Giants unsettle the camp. Ruga Ragetotem wants the specimens to study the danger and prepare Horde warriors for the alien menace moving into the plains.
